latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Build annotated 5-step cold call opener scripts with voicemail and gatekeeper variants.

- Produces a ready-to-use, annotated cold call opener following the Five-Step Telephone Prospecting Framework from "Fanatical Prospecting"
- Generates scripts in Name → Identify → Reason → Bridge (with explicit "because") → Ask order
- Enforces best practices: no "How are you today?" pause, silence after the ask, and natural delivery
- Includes voicemail and gatekeeper variants alongside live-answer script
- Integrates with upstream skills for call objective and message; accepts inputs from files or user prompts
- Focuses on sales reps (SDR, BDR, AE, founders) needing consistent, effective call openers
